pick.text: App tray: pick A, B or C

how.text: Press Play on A, B or C. Grid icon (top right) opens the tray; the gear opens Phone settings / LEGION settings. Search in the tray filters all apps. The five round buttons above Tap to talk replace the pinned dock: Bank, Maps and Mail have several apps and ask which; Music has one and opens it; Chat has none and asks you to pick. In any 'Open with' sheet, Choose apps lets you tick one or more.

same.text: Same in all three: the settings menu and the category buttons. Only the tray differs. A: one folder per letter, tap opens it. B: every letter is a collapsible section with a jump rail. C: letters grouped into folders of about five apps.
